patch:
diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py b/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py
index 1267cc2..7f53c3f 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py
@@ -44,6 +44,21 @@ Rules:
 - Validate generated artifacts from their saved bytes with the target tool or a format-aware
   parser that follows the consumer's conventions. Do not hard-code a second interpretation of
   field boundaries, sequence regions, query structure, or binary layout to prove intended values.
+- Re-read the ORIGINAL TASK before finishing and list every literal requirement: exact file paths,
+  names, output formats, CLI invocations, ports, and permissions. Verify each one with the exact
+  command or invocation the task text states, run from a clean state. Do not substitute your own
+  paraphrase of the requirement.
+- Hidden tests usually exercise edge cases and are stricter than the task examples. Before finish,
+  test at least one non-trivial or boundary input beyond the examples in the task text.
+- Remove build artifacts, scratch files, and background processes you created that the task did not
+  ask for, especially in output directories the task constrains. Leave required services running
+  and required files in place.
+- Spend turns economically. Batch independent observations into one execute, and prefer a
+  single script that builds and tests together. Do not spend more than a few turns on
+  exploration. If one approach fails twice for the same reason, change approach instead of
+  patching it again.
+- If the task is hard, deliver a working partial solution early and then improve it. A working
+  candidate in place when the budget ends scores better than an unfinished perfect design.
 - Use finish only after the task appears complete. Supply one to three fresh, self-contained checks.
   Each check runs in a separate disposable snapshot with no network and must exit nonzero when its
   stated condition is false.
